theme.archetype: Hybrid of Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) & Archetype 2 (The Performance Pro) — Elite Obsidian
theme.primary_vibe: Elite, intelligent, focused, emotionally calming, high-performance coaching

mono.usage: Timestamps, XP numbers, analytical scores, logical fallacy identifiers

components.cards: Solid background #18181B (zinc-900), 1px border #27272A (zinc-800), no aggressive drop shadow. Use inner highlights for premium depth.
components.buttons: Primary CTAs: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-full font-bold shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.4)]. Secondary: border border-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 rounded-full bg-zinc-900.
components.bottom_nav: Fixed to bottom, glassmorphic bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/5. Icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone style).
components.ai_feedback_card: Subtle blue tinted background (bg-blue-950/20) with a left border-l-2 border-blue-500. Timestamps in JetBrains Mono text-blue-400.
components.progress_rings: SVG circular progress indicator. Background ring stroke-zinc-800, active ring stroke-amber-500 (streaks) or blue-500 (scores).
components.charts: Recharts AreaChart or LineChart with thin lines (strokeWidth={2}), no grids, or very subtle dashed grid lines (stroke='#27272A'). Tooltips must be dark-themed with border-white/10.

motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}, animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
motion.modals: Slide up from bottom (y: '100%' to '0%') representing a React Native bottom sheet modal.
motion.ai_listening: Infinite pulse animation on the recording button: scale 1 to 1.05 with a soft drop-shadow glow.

ai_mentor.description: Glowing AI orb avatar representing the Claude 4.5 Mentor Chat.

gamification.description: Luxury gold/obsidian shield badge for user milestone popups and profile levels.

debate_mode.description: Elegant 3D microphone graphic for the AI debate training system entry point.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for a React web app that looks and feels exactly like a high-end React Native Expo iOS app. On desktop browsers, constrain the main layout to max-w-md or max-w-lg and center it on the screen with a dark background to simulate a mobile frame.
Implement a persistent Bottom Tab Navigation (Home, Train, Debate, Analyze, Mentor) using a sticky/fixed glassmorphic footer (z-50) over all scrollable content.
Do NOT use native HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use customized Shadcn elements designed to look like mobile bottom-sheet selectors or rounded dark popovers.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing their role (e.g., data-testid='start-debate-button', data-testid='home-tab').
Typography MUST use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings, Manrope for body text, and JetBrains Mono for numbers, metrics, and timestamps. DO NOT default to Inter.
Do not use #000000 (pure black). Base the app on #09090B (Zinc 950) and layer #18181B (Zinc 900) for cards.
Incorporate smooth entrance animations using Framer Motion. Apply staggered list animations for the daily missions and feedback items.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for all iconography. Use Duotone weight for general/inactive icons and Fill weight for active states.
Install the following dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, recharts, clsx, tailwind-merge, date-fns.

Ensure 'AI feedback cards' look distinct from normal content blocks: give them a subtle tinted background (blue-950/20) and a sharp 2px colored left border indicating the feedback type (emerald for praise, rose for critique).
